nodes.description: Public address state variable initialized to msg.sender; acts as the access-control owner of the contract.
Public uint state variable that records the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that assigns its argument to last_completed_migration.
Caller-controlled address used both to initialize owner and to satisfy the restricted modifier check.
Input parameter of setCompleted that is written into the last_completed_migration state variable.

edges.reason: owner is assigned from msg.sender at construction, so the deployer/caller identity determines who holds privileged ownership.
The restricted modifier compares msg.sender to owner and reverts unless they match, gating execution of setCompleted.
The completed parameter is passed into setCompleted and used as the value written to storage.
setCompleted writes the input value into the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: completed is a function parameter that exists only to carry a value into setCompleted, so it should be normalized into that function node.
